contea di ritrovamento: South Gloucestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [CONSTANT]INVS IVN N[OB C] ; R/ [GL]ORI[A EXERCITVS]

Copper alloy nummus of Constantine II. Date 330-335 A.D. Diameter 15mm, weight 1.2g. Obverse: Helmeted, laureate and mantled bust left holding sceptre across shoulder. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANT]INVS IVN N[OB C]. Reverse: two soldiers with one standard. Reverse inscription: [GL]ORI[A EXERCITVS]
